question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The theory or philosophy of law
solution: The correct answer is **"Jurisprudence."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Jurisprudence"** is the theory or philosophy of law. (क़ानून के दर्शन या सिद्धांत; धर्मशास्त्र, न्यायशास्त्र) • **Example**: *They were a part of a living, evolving tradition of **jurisprudence**__ which accepted contradictions within its fold.* • It comes from the Latin word **'juris prudentia'**, which means 'knowledge of law'. • It involves the study of legal systems, principles, and theories. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 - Pacifism** is the belief in peace and opposition to war or violence. (यह आस्‍था कि युद्घ सदैव अनुचित होते हैं और उस में कभी शामिल नहीं होना चाहिए; शांतिवाद) • **Option 3 - Cosmology** is the study of the universe and its origins. (ब्रह्मांड और उसकी उत्पत्ति का अध्ययन) • **Option 4 - Philia** is a Greek word for love or affection. (प्यार या स्नेह के लिए एक ग्रीक शब्द) 40:Tb07, The correct answer is **"Livestock."**
